title: Chapter 265 Bullying The Weak
content:
Chapter 265 Bullying The Weak

Thinking of the huge changes in the fairy world today, the delegation to the Deliberation Hall must have something to say about.

I don't know how long it took.

At the boundary of the fairyland wood fairyland.

Four figures appeared here.

"Here I'm back."

Looking at the fairy spirit in front of him, where the intensity of the fairy spirit was even stronger than that in the past, Qin Feng sighed.

Beside him, Xiao Luo looked at Lu Xue and said, "Sister Xue, are you going back to the academy now?"

Suddenly, Qin Feng and Yuanyuan also looked at Lu Xue.

Looking at the three of them, Lu Xue was about to speak when a deafening laugh suddenly sounded from the void.

The four of them were shocked.

I saw the void above suddenly cracked.

The next moment, a handsome man with a high ponytail stepped out of the crack in the void, with a proud and unruly smile on his face.

When the four of them saw the man, they looked solemn.

The peak powerhouse of the Immortal Emperor Realm!

None of the four people are ordinary people, so they are naturally very familiar with the aura of the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

At this time, the man in the void was also looking at Lu Xue and the other four.

The moment he saw Lu Xue, his pupils suddenly shrank, and then his whole body was trembling with excitement.

"I have great luck. I just woke up and actually encountered a genius like you."

"Is this the gift God has given me?"

Speaking of this, the man actually stretched out his tongue, licked the corner of his mouth, with a hideous smile on his face.

"My favorite thing is torture the genius and monsters."

When Lu Xue and the other two suddenly looked ugly when they heard the man's words.

Qin Feng stepped forward and said, "Senior, as a strong man in the Immortal Emperor Realm, do you really want to bully the small ones with the big ones?"

"If it is known to the world, you may be ridiculed by the world."

Qin Feng spoke slowly, trying to make the man in the void fear.

But it's a pity that he underestimated the face of the man in front of him.

"Brother? Haha, if I were afraid of ridicule, I would have been dead back then."

"If I were afraid of ridicule, I wouldn't have hiked until now."

"If I were afraid of ridicule, I would not be as I am now."

"Do you think people like me are afraid of ridicule?"

The long-haired man in the void stared at Qin Feng and sneered. The murderous intent in his eyes did not decrease at all, but became stronger.

Qin Feng's face looked ugly.

Seeing this, Xiao Luo stood up.

"I am a member of the Xiao clan. We are all students of Tiandi Academy. You may not take us seriously, but if you kill us, do you think the forces behind us will let you go?"

Xiao Luo directly moved out of the power behind him, hoping to threaten the other party with his hard power.

Hearing this, the man in the void also showed a hint of hesitation, but it was just a hint of it.

"The bigger the wind and waves, the more expensive the fish are. The more you say this, the more I want to kill you."

The man had already restrained the smile on his face and looked at Lu Xue and the others, as if he was looking at a dead person.

Xiao Luo clenched his fists.

The fairy world is so big, so everyone has it.

And at this time, Lu Xue stood up.

Now, all the backhands left by Lu Daosheng on her body have been sealed by Lu Daosheng.

Because in this way, Lu Xue truly relies on herself.

Of course, if Lu Xue is about to die, it would be another matter.

At this moment, Lu Xue faced the peak powerhouse in the Immortal Emperor Realm in front of her. Apart from some high-level magic weapons, the rest could only rely on her own real skills.

But Lu Xue doesn't even have the Immortal Lord realm, so how can she deal with a man who is so much higher than her?

I heard Lu Xue say directly: "Do you know who your father is?"

My father?

The three people beside him were slightly stunned. Hasn’t Senior Lu already left?

What's the use of mentioning this now?

The three of them were puzzled.

The man in the void also frowned slightly.

"Who?"

Lu Xue took a deep breath and said slowly, "Father, Lu Daosheng."

"I don't know."

The man waved his hand directly.

"I haven't even heard of it. I don't know which cat or dog it is. You actually want to scare me with this, haha."

But Lu Xue frowned slightly, "My father is very powerful. If you slander him like this, the consequences will be very serious."

However, the man still sneered, "Is that so powerful? Why didn't I see him come to save you?"

Lu Xue said in a faint voice: "He is so busy, you are like trash, and he probably won't even look at you even if he sees you."

"Ha ha ha ha!"

The man laughed out loud, as if he had heard something big joke.

But as he smiled, the man smiled abruptly.

Then, the man suddenly glared at Lu Xue and the other four below, his eyes filled with bloodshot, and he said hideously: "You are delaying time!!"

boom!

Realizing Lu Xue's purpose, the man no longer hesitated and rushed towards Lu Xue with all his might.

Kill Lu Xue and seize all her opportunities.

He believed that the opportunities in such a lucky genius would definitely greatly improve his foundation.

In the prosperous times, it is often even more cruel.

"You are presumptuous!"

Just as the man was about to succeed, an angry roar suddenly rang out from the void in the distance.

The next moment, a terrifying aura came and the entire void began to buzz.

The man's face suddenly looked extremely ugly when he noticed the aura coming from behind.

But at this moment, seeing that Lu Xue was already close, he didn't want to give up.

Immediately, his body did not retreat, but suddenly accelerated.

Bang!

A shining light suddenly enveloped Lu Xue and the other two.

A small tower appeared out of thin air in Lu Xue's hand, which was obviously a considerable defensive magic weapon.

But the next moment.

There was a click.

The small tower cracked.

The entire defense shield collapsed directly.

Seeing this scene, Qin Feng and Xiao Luo hurriedly stood in front of Lu Xue.

Looking at Qin Feng and the others, Lu Xue's expression moved slightly.

The man who had already rushed in front of him looked disdainful.

Two ants around the Immortal Lord Realm wanted to block themselves.

boom!

After a loud bang.

The long-haired man was actually knocked back hundreds of feet away.

I saw a one-armed man standing here in front of Lu Xue and the other two, looking at the long-haired man in the distance with a cold expression.

"Ancestor Xiao Meng!"

Seeing the one-armed man in front of him, Xiao Luo suddenly yelled excitedly.

Xiao Meng is one of the twelve peak powerhouses of the Xiao clan.

Nowadays, the Xiao clan is powerful and even in this prosperous era, it is one of the few powerful forces.

The twelve peak powerhouses in the Immortal Emperor Realm are even respected as the Twelve Ancestors by the Xiao clan.

Xiao Meng is one of them.

Just as the long-haired man showed murderous intention, Xiao Luo had already crushed a jade talisman to send a message.

As a big family, how could he not have a life-saving thing on his body?

The Jade Talisman is one of them.

In the distance, the long-haired man looked at Xiao Meng with a serious expression, just about to speak.

Buzz —

The void in the distance cracked again.

Two figures slowly stepped out from it.

Two peak powerhouses in the Immortal Emperor Realm!

Seeing this scene, the long-haired man broke through the space and fled the scene without any nonsense.
